title: 2.9 Unit 2 Review
unit_title: Unit 2: Places, Objects, Numbers, and Colors
unit_outcome: Recognize common surroundings and identify, count, and describe concrete objects without using untaught location language.
lesson_title: Unit 2: Places, Objects, Numbers, and Colors
goal: Review Unit 2 through fresh surroundings, object identification, true near/far contrasts, quantities and colors, then recognize the final numbers by ear. No new language.
grammar_function: Mixed What is it?, It is..., This/That is..., and number-color-noun phrases.
speaking_outcome: Repeat six representative Unit 2 utterances across identity, demonstrative, and description functions.
